name: SocialDesk
summary: AI social media tool for scheduling posts, a unified inbox for comments and DMs, and AI auto-replies across Instagram, TikTok, X, LinkedIn, Facebook and Threads, for solo creators, teams and agencies.
best_for: solo creators, small brands and agencies that want scheduling, a shared DMs and comments inbox and AI auto-replies across six platforms for under $100 a month
skip_if: you need Pinterest or other platforms beyond the six listed, want a permanent free plan, or need independently verified security certificates before you connect client accounts
honest_knock: The page shows dollar signs without naming a currency, and we could not read the yearly amounts behind the "2 months free" toggle. The page says SocialDesk adheres to SOC 2 and GDPR standards but shows no certificate, and the statistics on the page are the vendor's own, not our measurement. Pinterest is not supported yet.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Starter · Starter billed monthly, shown with a dollar sign (the page names no ISO currency code): 5 social accounts, 1 workspace, 1 user, 10 AI images a month
pricing.notes: (read 2026-11-06 on socialdesk.ai) SocialDesk sells four monthly plans and every one starts with a 7-day free trial that, per the page, needs no credit card. Starter costs $19 a month for 5 social accounts, 1 workspace, 1 user, unlimited scheduled posts, 10 AI images a month, AI auto-replies for comments and DMs, a unified inbox and MCP access. Team costs $39 a month and adds 20 social accounts, unlimited team members and workspaces, 20 AI images, a post approval workflow, API access and priority support. Pro costs $59 a month for 50 accounts and 50 AI images, and Max costs $99 a month for 100 accounts, 100 AI images and VIP priority support. A Yearly toggle on the page says "2 months free", but we did not read the resulting yearly amounts. The page shows dollar signs without naming a currency and does not mention tax. Custom limits, invoicing and onboarding are available through contact@socialdesk.ai.
